title: Complete Project Multi-Tenant Architecture Audit, Remediation, and Independent Verification Report

environment.architecture: Shared Database with Discriminator Column (`tenant_id`), Dynamic Context RLS, and Service/Repository ScopeGuard Layer

discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.title: Radiology Order Creation Hardcoded Fallback UUIDs
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.vulnerability: The repository silently injected hardcoded fallback UUIDs (11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111 and 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001) into new radiology orders whenever tenant or branch context was absent, leaking cross-tenant records into seed partitions.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.rootCause: Silent default fallback values implemented as developer convenience during early prototyping.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.remediation: Removed all hardcoded fallback UUIDs. Enforced fail-closed validation: if tenantId or branchId is missing from session/input, the repository immediately throws AppError.badRequest with explicit diagnostics.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.verification: Verified via Test T17: Requests omitting tenant or branch context fail immediately with 400 Bad Request instead of creating orphaned or cross-tenant records.

discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.title: Procurement Overview Simulated Fallback on Test Seed UUIDs
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.vulnerability: The procurement overview methods (getStats and getAnalytics) contained an explicit bypass checking for seed tenant IDs (00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001, 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111) and returned hardcoded synthetic statistics (e.g. 42 active vendors, INR 1,250,000 spend) instead of genuine database data.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.rootCause: Mock data bypasses left in repository production paths.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.remediation: Eliminated all seed tenant hardcoded bypasses. The repository now queries PostgreSQL exclusively for all tenants and returns genuine zero-state metrics (0 vendors, 0 spend) when no data exists.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.verification: Verified via Test T19: Tenant A with 0 procurement orders returns genuine 0 statistics across all fields with zero synthetic leakage.

discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.title: WhatsApp Engagement Hardcoded Fallbacks and Unscoped Inbound Webhook
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.vulnerability: The repository defaulted missing tenantId to 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111 and branchId to branch_default, and automatically injected fake queue token IDs (lqt-1). Additionally, the inbound webhook endpoint did not enforce tenant identification.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.rootCause: Incomplete webhook payload validation and developer fallback defaults.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.remediation: Removed all hardcoded UUID and string fallbacks. Inbound webhooks now strictly require a resolvable tenantId in payload or query parameter, failing closed with 400 Bad Request if missing.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.verification: Verified via Test T21: WhatsApp webhook rejecting payload missing tenant context.

discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.title: License Governance Default Fallback UUIDs and Unauthenticated Status Endpoint
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.vulnerability: Endpoints /api/v1/license/status, /generate-offline-token, and /heartbeat defaulted missing tenantId to 44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444, allowing callers without valid tenant sessions to view and manipulate offline license states.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.rootCause: Permissive dev-mode fallbacks left in route controllers.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.remediation: Added strict session and tenant validation. /api/v1/license/status enforces authenticate middleware (returns 401 unauthenticated), and token generation/heartbeat endpoints strictly require tenantId.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.verification: Verified via Test T20: Unauthenticated requests to /api/v1/license/status return 401 Unauthorized; token generation requires authenticated tenant context.

discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.title: Wholesale Invoice Ingestion Cross-Partner Parameter Tampering
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.vulnerability: The service permitted callers to supply partnerId in request body/parameters. If session tenant did not match, it fell back to session but did not explicitly reject malicious tampering attempts.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.remediation: Enforced strict parameter validation: if client supplies a partnerId that does not match session.tenantId (and caller is not Super Admin), the service immediately throws 403 Forbidden with "Access denied: Cross-partner parameter tampering is strictly forbidden".
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.verification: Verified via Test T18: Calling wholesale ingestion with mismatched partnerId is rejected with 403 Forbidden.

discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.title: AuthGuard URL Parameter Tampering Detection Gap
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.vulnerability: AuthGuard inspected body.partnerId, body.tenantId, and query params, but missed route params (e.g. /partner/:partnerId/...) in certain fastify param configurations.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.remediation: Added params["partnerId"] and params["partner_id"] to clientPartnerId tampering detection matrix in auth-guard.ts.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.verification: Verified via Tests T9, T10, T11, T12: Header, body, query, and path parameter tampering attempts are all intercepted and rejected with 403 Forbidden.

discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.title: Audit Repository Resolved Branch Tenant Fallback UUID
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.vulnerability: When resolving branch tenant context for audit logging, the repository defaulted unresolved branch tenant to 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.rootCause: Legacy default fallback in audit trail resolution.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.remediation: Removed fallback UUID. Unresolved branches now strictly retain the session.tenantId or fail without corrupting audit partitions.
discoveredDefectsAndRemediations.verification: Verified via static audit scan and live multi-tenant execution proof.
